r: We are seeking a highly qualified and experienced Senior Accountant with strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) to join our finance team.

The ideal candidate should have a solid accounting background within a diversified business environment, with the ability to independently manage the full accounting cycle, ensure accurate financial reporting, maintain effective financial controls, and support management in financial and operational decision-making.
Manage the full accounting cycle, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations.
Perform and review accounting transactions through Microsoft Dynamics NAV.
Prepare accurate financial statements, management reports, and financial analyses.
Ensure timely monthly and annual financial closing.
Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations across group entities.
Monitor project accounting, job costing, subcontractor accounts, and project profitability.
Oversee inventory accounting, cost allocation, and fixed asset management.
Monitor cash flow, receivables, payables, and working capital.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
Ensure compliance with IFRS, applicable regulatory requirements, and internal financial policies.
Coordinate with external auditors and support audit requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, ERP utilization, and internal controls.
